purpose: Source-authored contracts for Conflux elemental-family consumer predicates. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.

requiredStaticSemantics: attacker or affected unit family selection
forbiddenSubstitutes: Conflux faction membership counted as elemental family
any elemental unit counted without specific family identity
Pixie or Firebird counted as elemental family source
spell school counted as unit elemental family
building elemental category counted as unit elemental family
RequiresElementalFamily.notes: Elemental Aspect requires exact authored elemental-family identity for the relevant unit before applying family-specific stat aspect behavior. Runtime still needs battle unit SID, selected family, damage ordering, and owner correlation proof.

requiredStaticSemantics: explicit Conflux elemental alignment building mapping
forbiddenSubstitutes: Conflux town membership counted as elemental building mapping
building display name or icon counted as elemental building mapping
elemental-themed source mechanic counted without exact currentRows contract
unit elemental family counted as building elemental mapping
building allowlist counted without elemental-building group proof
construction UI preview counted as committed elemental building mapping
RequiresElementalBuildingMapping.notes: Planar Alignment requires an exact elemental-building group mapping from construction building category contracts. Runtime still needs city/building payload, commit ordering, owner correlation, and extra-build idempotence proof.

requiredRuntimeProof: battle unit SID to elemental family proof
selected elemental family to stat-aspect proof
construction building SID or row proof
idempotent per-hit or per-build application proof
